abstract_algebra: Abstract algebra centered on group theory, encompassing order of elements, factor groups, permutations, and isomorphism. Addresses homomorphisms, normal subgroups, and Abelian composition laws. Explores integral domains, fields of quotients, and Euler's totient function in analyzing element orders within symmetric groups.
anatomy: Anatomy covering head and neck structures: parotid gland, maxillary sinus, pharyngeal arches, and trachea; thoracic anatomy including lung lobes and heart auscultation sites; cartilage function, emissary veins, sinus pain referral, tonsillar tissue, with neuroanatomical and physiological integration.
astronomy: Astronomy encompassing solar system formation theories, planetary differentiation, and lunar maria genesis. Integrates atmospheric loss mechanisms, Venus radar surface mapping, and axial tilt-driven seasons. Covers planetary thermal evolution, orbital dynamics, blackbody radiation principles, and exploration challenges in planetary science.
business_ethics: Business ethics integrates corporate governance frameworks, director accountability, and CSR strategies aligned with global sustainability goals. It examines Kantian duty ethics, executive responsibilities, business-civil society partnerships, and stakeholder communication barriers, addressing power dynamics, agency relationships, and ethical challenges in corporate ownership and operational practices.
college_computer_science: College computer science focusing on symbol tables, hashing, recursion, computability, memory management, automata, and data structure complexity. Integrates page replacement, matrix factorization, distributed systems, and logic programming strategies, bridging theoretical foundations with algorithmic and systems analysis.
high_school_chemistry: High school chemistry encompassing Lewis structures, molecular geometry, and bonding; electron configurations, atomic structure, and periodic trends including acid strength. Topics include thermodynamics, enthalpy changes, and Gibbs free energy. Buffer solutions, pH regulation, and acid-base equilibria. Reaction kinetics, catalysts, and rate laws. Additional areas: molar mass, stoichiometry, solubility, intermolecular forces, and gas analysis.
high_school_geography: High school geography encompasses central place theory, demographic transition model stages, primary economic activities, migration reasons, gerrymandering, and distance decay. It integrates urban dynamics, population distribution, political-territorial organization, cultural landscapes, and environmental factors, including zoning, gentrification, federal states, language families, and climate patterns.
jurisprudence: Jurisprudence encompassing normative theories (Natural Law, soft positivism), penal theory (retribution), legal codification (Bentham’s arguments), critical analysis (Dworkin’s critique of economic analysis of law, CRT, gender perspectives), structural aspects (sovereignty, local lawmaking), and comparative law, including psychological explanations of legal norms.
world_religions: World religions scholarship encompasses Islamic Shari'ah law, Sikh heritage including Guru Arjan and Darbar Sahib, early Christian roles like deaconesses, Calvinist predestination, North American Buddhism, Jaina meditation, Sadducean Torah interpretation, and broader themes such as comparative religious movements (e.g., Kokugaku, Bushido), theological doctrines (Augustine, Calvin), and cross-cultural spiritual practices.
formal_logic: Formal logic involves conditional propositions, natural language symbolization, truth table analyses for equivalence, consistency, and validity—including indirect methods—predicate logic translation with quantifiers and connectives, and evaluation of argument validity via counterexamples and logical equivalence/contradiction.
general: Handles queries that do not fall within the capabilities of any available specialist service.
